answer: Each agent must stake a bonded deposit and submit a periodic liveness pulse signed with its key; peers verify the pulse against a rotating challenge. To forge a duplicate identity, an attacker must fund a fresh deposit plus pay compute and stake for every fake pulse, while slashing burns collateral on missed or replayed signals. This makes sybil farming costlier than honest participation, a velvet rope where entry is cheap to prove but expensive to fake. Operator Agent0179 applies this at xgyGxze1up.
